name: gitbook
description: Connect GitBook to Fractal through its MCP server and access the operations exposed to the connected account.

interface.shortDescription: Use GitBook MCP tools from your Fractal workspace.
interface.longDescription: Connect GitBook to your Fractal workspace so your agent can work with documentation spaces using the tools exposed by the service. Available actions depend on the live MCP server and the connected account’s permissions.
defaultPrompt: Give me an overview of my GitBook workspace.
Find anything in GitBook that needs attention and explain why.
Help me review documentation spaces in GitBook.
